title: File Handling and Exceptions
description: Learn how to work with files in Python—reading, writing, and managing them—and handle exceptions to build robust and error-resilient programs.

lessons.title: Introduction to File Handling
lessons.content: File handling in Python allows you to create, read, write, and delete files. This is useful for data storage, configuration, and logging.

lessons.title: Opening and Reading a File
lessons.content:
```python
file = open("sample.txt", "r")
content = file.read()
print(content)
file.close()
```
